Public broadcasters such as 
the BBC, ITV, and Channel 4 
remain the most trusted news 
brands. Popular outlets such 
as the Sun, the Mail and the 
Mirror attract big audiences 
online but their news coverage 
is often strongly distrusted. 
New TV channel GB News is 
struggling to build trust with 
general audiences even as it 
builds loyalty with some on 
the right.
Trust = % scored 6–10 on 10-point scale, Don’t trust = 0–4, Neither = 5. Those that
